step1.title: 1️⃣ Register PDF Materials
step1.catalog: Download from recommended free material sites

step2.title: 2️⃣ Configure SNS Access Permissions
step2.line2: Set SNS usage time limit (5-60 minutes)
step2.line3: SNS links become active for the set duration after grading

step3.title: 3️⃣ Study with PDF
step3.line3: Write directly with finger or Apple Pencil
step3.line4: Pinch to zoom, 2-finger drag to pan

step4.title: 4️⃣ AI Grading
step4.line2: Drag to select the area to grade
step4.line4: AI automatically grades and provides feedback
step4.warning: ⚠️ AI grading is not 100% accurate. Parents must verify.

step1.title: 1️⃣ Add a Reference PDF
step1.catalog: Import a reference PDF you found on the web
step1.local: Add a PDF saved on your device

step2.title: 2️⃣ Choose Your AI Teacher
step2.line2: Enable the teacher levels you want to use
step2.line3: Choose which teacher appears by default

step3.title: 3️⃣ Copy While Looking at the Reference
step3.line1: Open a PDF to see the reference on side A and a blank canvas on side B
step3.line3: Draw freely on side B with your finger or Apple Pencil
step3.line4: Pinch each side to zoom, and drag with two fingers to pan

step4.title: 4️⃣ Ask the AI Teacher
step4.line1Tap: to choose a teacher and start the review
step4.line2: First, position and zoom sides A and B so they are easy to compare
step4.line3: The currently visible A and B views are sent to the AI as they appear
step4.line4: The AI compares the mood and shapes, then shares strengths and a next practice point
step4.warning: ⚠️ AI advice is a reference, not a final judgment of the value of your artwork.

drillCatalog.title: 📚 Recommended Free Worksheets
drillCatalog.description: Download PDFs from the sites below and add them using the '+ Add PDF' button on the home screen.
drillCatalog.tipsContent:
K5 Learning offers comprehensive worksheets organized by grade and topic.
Download the PDF and print it out for a great workbook experience!
drillCatalog.disclaimer:
※ Please use materials from each site in accordance with their respective terms of use.
HomeTeacher only provides links and is not the distributor.

sites.name: ThousandsOfTies Drills
sites.description: Sample worksheets created by the developers. Useful for testing and demos.

sites.name: K5 Learning
sites.description: Free worksheets for kindergarten to grade 5. Organized by grade and topic.

sites.name: Math-Drills.com
sites.description: One of the largest collections of free math worksheets. Over 50,000 pages.

sites.name: Dad's Worksheets
sites.description: Focused on math practice. Great for specific topics like fractions or geometry.

sites.name: Math Worksheets 4 Kids
sites.description: A wealth of worksheets for Math, English, Science, and Social Studies.

sites.name: Education.com
sites.description: High quality worksheets. Some require a free account to download.

drawingCatalog.title: 🎨 Recommended Free Drawing Materials
drawingCatalog.description:
Download a PDF you want to practice from one of these sites,
then add it to CopiCopi with the import button at the bottom right of the home screen.
drawingCatalog.tipsContent:
Start with a simple step-by-step worksheet.
Even when the reference and practice space share one PDF page, CopiCopi lets you view it on side A and copy it onto a blank side B.
drawingCatalog.disclaimer:
※ Follow each site's terms of use.
CopiCopi does not redistribute these materials and only links to their official pages.

sites.name: SuperColoring Drawing Tutorials
sites.description: A large collection of printable step-by-step drawing guides for animals, people, vehicles, plants, and more.

sites.name: How to Draw for Kids
sites.description: Simple tutorials and downloadable worksheets with drawing, tracing, coloring, and grid-copying activities.

sites.name: LittleActivity Art Printables
sites.description: Free printable PDF art activities and drawing tutorials for children, with no account required.

about.title: 🦉 About TutoTuto
about.intro: TutoTuto lets you require your child to study in this app before using social media. Register learning materials as PDF files, write directly on them, and let AI grade the answers.
about.pdfDescription: — Register and manage PDF learning materials in the app
about.drawingDescription: — Edit PDFs directly with a stylus or your finger
about.gradingDescription: — Grade answers automatically using Google Gemini AI
about.snsDescription: — Allow time-limited social media access after grading
about.devicesDescription: You can use the app on the following devices and browsers:
about.creditsDescription: TutoTuto uses the following technologies and services:
about.gemini: Google Gemini AI — automatic grading engine
about.aiBefore: This app’s automatic grading uses Google Gemini AI, but
about.aiWarning: grading results may not always be accurate
about.aiAfter: . AI decisions may contain mistakes. Parents should always check their child’s answers and make the final decision on correctness. Use this feature only as a learning support tool.

contact.title: 📧 Contact
contact.intro: For questions, comments, requests, or bug reports about TutoTuto, please contact us at the email address below.
contact.responseTime: Depending on your inquiry, it may take some time to respond
contact.deviceInfo: When reporting a bug, please include your device and browser information
contact.reply: We generally respond to inquiries by email
contact.storageQuestion: Q: Where is my data stored?
contact.storageAnswer: A: All data is stored on your device in the browser’s IndexedDB. It is not sent to an external server.
contact.syncQuestion: Q: Can I share data between devices?
contact.syncAnswer: A: There is currently no data synchronization between devices. Data is saved separately on each device.
contact.deleteQuestion: Q: How do I delete my data?
contact.deleteAnswer: A: Open “Storage” on the app’s Admin screen and select “Delete All” to delete all saved data.

privacy.title: 🔒 Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: TutoTuto (the “App”) respects your privacy and strives to protect your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how the App handles information.
privacy.collectionDescription: The App stores the following information only on your device:
privacy.pdf: PDF files registered as learning materials
privacy.settings: App settings, such as social media time limits and notification settings
privacy.localData: All this information is stored on your device in IndexedDB and is not sent to an external server.
privacy.aiDescription: When you use the App’s AI grading feature, images to be graded are sent to the Google Gemini API. The transmitted data is used only for grading and is handled according to Google’s privacy policy.
privacy.adsDescription: The App may display advertisements using Google AdSense. Google AdSense may use cookies to display advertisements based on your interests.
privacy.adsBefore: For information about advertising by Google, please see
privacy.cookiesDescription: The App may use cookies to serve advertisements and improve the service. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.
privacy.deleteDescription: You can delete data saved in the App by deleting site data in your browser settings or using the App’s “Delete All” feature.
privacy.contactDescription: For inquiries about this Privacy Policy, please contact:
privacy.changesDescription: This Privacy Policy may be changed as needed. We will notify you of changes within the App.

terms.title: 📋 Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service (the “Terms”) define the conditions for using TutoTuto (the “App”). Please read these Terms carefully before using the App.
terms.serviceDescription: The App is a parental control app for limiting children’s social media use and encouraging study habits. You can require study in the App before allowing social media access. It provides the following learning features:
terms.sns: Allowing time-limited social media access after grading
terms.conditionsDescription: By using the App, you agree to the following conditions:
terms.parentalUse: Use the App for parental management of children’s learning and social media use
terms.agreement: Agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy
terms.compliance: Comply with copyright and other applicable laws
terms.unlawfulUse: Using the App for unlawful purposes
terms.overload: Placing an excessive load on the App’s systems
terms.excessiveGrading: Excessive use of AI grading in a short period, including continuous grading with automated tools
terms.sourceCode: Copying, modifying, or redistributing the App’s source code without permission
terms.rights: Infringing the rights of other users or third parties
terms.disclaimerDescription: The App is provided “as is.” The operator assumes no responsibility for the following:

terms.accuracy: The accuracy of AI grading results (AI grading may contain errors, and parents are responsible for the final judgment)
terms.interruption: Interruption or termination of the App
terms.thirdPartyAccess: Access or use by third parties
terms.adsDescription: The App may display Google AdSense advertisements. Advertisement content is provided by third parties, and the operator is not responsible for it.
terms.serviceChangesTitle: 6. Changes to or termination of the service
terms.serviceChangesDescription: The operator may change the App or terminate its provision without prior notice.
terms.restrictionsDescription: The operator may restrict or suspend use of the App without prior notice in the following cases:
terms.excessiveUse: Excessive use of AI grading is detected
terms.violation: A violation of these Terms is confirmed
